title: Shizuoka — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Shizuoka: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Shizuoka has a population of 700,000. A coastal city with views of Mount Fuji, famous for green tea, fresh seafood, and a mild climate. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 147 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
